description: Checks and previews for the maldives theme. Run from this folder.

scripts.frames: esbuild frames.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=build/frames.cjs --log-level=warning && node build/frames.cjs && node render.cjs
scripts.sides: esbuild sides-lead.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=build/sides-lead.cjs --log-level=warning && node build/sides-lead.cjs && esbuild sides-fleet.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=build/sides-fleet.cjs --log-level=warning && node build/sides-fleet.cjs
